title: SafeRoute scaling stages
subtitle: Each step is added only when measurements cross a trigger (Plan v7 §14.2)

nodes.label: Stage 0 · MVP ≤10k users: 1 API, 1 worker, OSRM, smallest Cloud SQL
Stage 1 · ~100k users: segment-level safety precompute, CDN-cached safety cells, connection pooling, bigger Cloud SQL
Stage 2 · ~1M users: Redis live snapshots, SSE/WebSocket gateway, self-hosted tiles + geocoder, read replica, split workers
Stage 3 · multi-city: per-city OSRM graphs, city partition key, SOS-path second region
